# 🌀 Aether **Advanced Routing System for WaterdogPE & Allay** ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL%203.0-blue.svg) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-0.1.0-green.svg) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-purple.svg) ![Allay](https://img.shields.io/badge/Allay-0.27.0-orange.svg) ![WaterdogPE](https://img.shields.io/badge/WaterdogPE-2.0+-blue.svg)
[![Русский](https://img.shields.io/badge/Язык-Русский-red?style=for-the-badge&logo=google-translate&logoColor=white)](README_RU.md)
--- **Aether** is a powerful and lightweight two-plugin routing system designed for **WaterdogPE** and **Allay** networks. It replaces the old bloated stack with a clean, predictable architecture. ### ✨ Features - **Embedded ProxyTransport on Allay**: No separate `ProxyTransport-Allay` jar needed — it's built right in. - **Lobby Portals**: Region-based portals with cooldowns, targeting specific servers or groups. - **Join Routing**: Route new players by group and permission rules on first connection. - **Maintenance Mode**: Global maintenance with bypass permissions and fallback routing. - **LuckPerms Integration**: Portal access checks and placeholders on the Allay side. - **PlaceholderAPI Integration**: Node, router, global, and LuckPerms placeholders. - **Localized Messages**: All user-facing text stored in `messages.yml` with MiniMessage templates. - **Metrics Export**: Prometheus-compatible `/metrics` endpoint on WaterdogPE. - **Minimal Architecture**: Only `core`, `allay`, and `waterdog` — nothing extra. ### 🏗️ Architecture ```text Bedrock Client | v WaterdogPE + Aether-Waterdog + ProxyTransport-Waterdog | | control-plane + routing v Allay Node + Aether-Allay + embedded ProxyTransport-Allay runtime ``` ### 📦 Plugin Layout | Plugin | Platform | Role | |--------|----------|------| | `Aether-Waterdog` | WaterdogPE | Router, node registry, join routing, maintenance, metrics | | `Aether-Allay` | Allay | Node heartbeat, embedded transport runtime, portals, placeholders | | `ProxyTransport-Waterdog` | WaterdogPE | External transport plugin (required separately) | ### 🎮 Commands #### Waterdog | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/aether status` | Show router summary. | | `/aether nodes` | Show all known nodes. | | `/aether reload` | Reload Aether config. | | `/aether route ` | Force-route a player. | | `/aether maintenance on [reason]` | Enable maintenance mode. | | `/aether maintenance off` | Disable maintenance mode. | #### Allay | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/aether status` | Show node and router state. | | `/aether reload` | Reload Allay-side config. | | `/aether portal ` | Trigger a configured portal manually. | ### 📊 Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | |-------------|-------------| | `%aether_router_connected%` | Router connection status | | `%aether_router_maintenance%` | Maintenance mode status | | `%aether_global_online%` | Total players online | | `%aether_global_max%` | Max player capacity | | `%aether_node_id%` | Current node ID | | `%aether_node_online%` | Players on current node | | `%aether_node_tps%` | Current node TPS | | `%aether_lp_primary_group%` | LuckPerms primary group | | `%aether_lp_prefix%` | LuckPerms prefix | ### 📁 Config Files #### Allay | File | Purpose | |------|---------| | `config.yml` | Node identity, router connection, embedded transport, PlaceholderAPI, LuckPerms | | `messages.yml` | Localized MiniMessage templates | | `portals.yml` | Lobby portal regions and targets | #### Waterdog | File | Purpose | |------|---------| | `config.yml` | Control-plane bind, groups, join rules, maintenance, metrics | | `messages.yml` | Localized router messages | ### 🛠️ Installation #### WaterdogPE 1. Install `ProxyTransport-Waterdog` as a separate plugin. 2. Place `Aether-Waterdog-0.1.0.jar` into the proxy `plugins/` folder. 3. Ensure your Waterdog backend server names match Aether node `serverId`. 4. Set the same `sharedSecret` on both Waterdog and Allay. 5. Restart the proxy. #### Allay 1. Place `Aether-Allay-0.1.0.jar` into the server plugin folder. 2. Configure `serverId`, groups, public address, and router connection. 3. Place QUIC certificate files in the configured transport paths (if embedded transport is enabled). 4. Restart the server. ### 📋 Requirements - **Java 21+** - **Allay 0.27.0** - **WaterdogPE 2.0+** - **ProxyTransport-Waterdog** on the proxy - **LuckPerms** (optional, recommended) - **PlaceholderAPI** (optional, Allay only) ### 🔨 Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/Miroshka000/Aether.git cd Aether ./gradlew build ``` Output jars: - `aether-allay/build/libs/Aether-Allay-0.1.0.jar` - `aether-waterdog/build/libs/Aether-Waterdog-0.1.0.jar` ### ⚠️ Important Notes - Aether does **not** replace `ProxyTransport-Waterdog`. - Aether does **not** use the old web panel, addons system, distributed PDC, or legacy bridge modules. - This is a clean rewrite from scratch. ---

Created by Miroshka for clean WaterdogPE + Allay networks with ❤️

versions.changelog:
## Aether v0.1.0

Clean `0.1.x` generation of Aether for AllayMC and WaterdogPE.

### Downloads

- `Aether-Allay-*.jar` - install on each Allay node
- `Aether-Waterdog-*.jar` - install on WaterdogPE proxy

### Included in this line

- embedded ProxyTransport runtime inside Aether
- lobby portals
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- LuckPerms integration on Allay
- routing, maintenance mode and diagnostics on Waterdog

### Notes

- `ProxyTransport-Waterdog` no longer needs to be installed separately when using `Aether-Waterdog`
- QUIC backend type is configured in Waterdog `config.yml`

Full changelog: https://github.com/Miroshka000/Aether/commits/v0.1.0
